Details, every adjustment to the cent, and the records behind each are in
[`deliverables/audit-report.md`](deliverables/audit-report.md); the questions for each employer are in
[`deliverables/audit-questions.md`](deliverables/audit-questions.md).

## How the results were verified

1. **Automated checks.** `verify_outputs.py` re-reads the guide and each payroll register from the downloaded source and
   checks, for all six employers: the exact CSV header; one row per code; no zero rows; dollars to the cent without
   separators; each `rationale_ref` is the guide paragraph that describes the code; the CSV total equals the register
   total plus the additions the run reports (uninsured subcontractors, undocumented allowances); every employee's
   portions add up to the register wages; one report and one question section per employer; every code, amount,
   adjustment and record appears in the report; every adjustment and every record relied on has at least one question;
   every question names its subject. Result on the committed outputs: 330 of 330 checks passed.
2. **The checker catches errors.** On a copy of the outputs with a thousands separator, a wrong `rationale_ref`, a zero
   row and a renamed subcontractor in the questions, it reported 9 failures and exited 1.
3. **Hand recalculation.** The figures were recomputed independently from the source files: Bay Crest roofing 8016
   hours, siding 4864, gutters 928; Darnell Price 61240.55 x 272 / 1776 = 9379.18 to R-320. Severn uninsured payments
   Tidewater Drywall 18240.55 + 22915.10 and Kent Island Roofing after 2026-01-31 19880.45 + 11765.20. Patuxent travel
   allowance 65.00 a day for 40 days (2600.00), Kyle Brandt 390.00 with no travel days. Annapolis Lena Ortiz 60 ride-along
   days x 912.35 / 6 = 9123.50; the weekly payroll totals equal the register for all six employees.
4. **Same result on Python 3.9 and 3.10**, and the error paths were exercised: unknown employer, a folder missing a
   required file, and a non-numeric timesheet value each stop that employer with a clear message and write nothing for
   it.

以下是作業要求在 coding session 裡用自己的話寫下的判斷：每家雇主自報的薪資拆分我接不接受、根據哪份紀錄。原文用英文，因為是給評分的人看的：

> **Do I accept each employer's own payroll split?**
>
> **Harbor Point Legal: accepted.** The payroll register puts all five employees under C-110 for 425148.16, exactly as the application says. Tomas Reyes, the paralegal, signed in six times at Sallowmere Court Condominiums, so strictly his work is not confined to the office. Still, the firm has no code other than C-110 and nothing records physical work, so his pay stays under C-110 and the employer is asked what he did there. Rests on payroll-register.csv, checked against site-signin-log.csv.
>
> **Bay Crest Exteriors: not accepted.** The employer put three roofers, two siding installers and the estimator under C-110. The crew timesheets record every crew day by type of work, so I divided each crew member's wages by hours (CG-07): roofing to R-310, siding and gutters to R-320. Estimator Teresa Lindqvist signed in at job sites on 9 days, so she is not confined to the office. Her pay goes to the principal business code R-310. Roofing hours (8016) exceed siding plus gutters (5792), even though the owner says siding is most of what they sell now. Only the bookkeeper stays in C-110. Rests on crew-timesheets.csv, site-signin-log.csv and payroll-register.csv.
>
> **Severn Homebuilders: not accepted.** Two of the three people the employer calls office staff go to the building sites: office manager Dana Whitcomb (11 sign-ins) and estimator Marissa Gale (4). Their pay goes to H-420. The employer says all subcontractors are insured, but Tidewater Drywall has no certificate, so 41155.65 is counted under H-420. Kent Island Roofing's certificate ended 2026-01-31, so the two later payments (31645.65) are counted under R-310. Rests on site-signin-log.csv, subcontractor-payments.csv, insurance-certificates.csv and payroll-register.csv.
>
> **Patuxent Electric: not accepted.** Owner Raymond Dunmore has not filed an election of exclusion. He is listed as a master electrician and signed in at job sites on 214 days, so his 118000.00 belongs under E-510, not under C-110 as "management" (CG-05). Travel allowance backed by recorded travel days stays out of payroll as a documented expense. Kyle Brandt's 390.00, paid with no travel days recorded, is payroll under E-510. Rests on payroll-register.csv (wages, travel days and allowance) and site-signin-log.csv.
>
> **Annapolis Courier: not accepted.** The route log shows dispatcher Lena Ortiz riding on delivery vans on 60 days, up to 3 days in some weeks, which is more than the "at most two fifths" the employer claims. Paul Haskins rode on 2 days. Under CG-07 that pay moves to T-610: 9123.50 and 299.20, priced from the weekly payroll. Rests on route-log.csv and weekly-payroll.csv.
>
> **Larkspur Lane Bistro: accepted.** The payroll register matches the split to the cent, and CG-42 places a restaurant's own catering crew under F-720. The field notes say the crew works restaurant shifts on quiet weeks. There are no time records for those shifts, and the dining-room and catering receipts are sales figures, not time, so I do not divide the payroll; the employer is asked for shift records. Rests on payroll-register.csv.

### 驗證

每一條都寫在 `references/decision-rules.md`，也印在受影響那家的報告段落，並轉成一題問雇主。

1. **A1 辦公室人員到工地**：只要有工地簽到紀錄，就不算「confined to an office」（CG-04）；沒有工時紀錄可拆（CG-07），整筆薪資歸主要業務 code（CG-02），不管去幾次。只有 C-110 的公司（Harbor）則維持 C-110 並發問。
2. **A2 主要業務 code**：用紀錄算出 C-110 以外薪資最多的 code。
3. **A3 出差津貼**：有記錄出差天數、按最常見日額（65.00）以內的部分算有據可查的費用，不算薪資；超過的部分或沒有天數的（Kyle Brandt 390.00）算薪資。Tyrone Banks 日額 47.00 不同，已發問。
4. **A4 隨車拆分**：隨車一天算一整天 T-610；員工每週工作天數用 route log 當週營運天數（6 天），因為辦公室人員沒有出勤紀錄。
5. **A5 分包商名稱**：付款名稱是保險證明持有人名稱的縮寫（Kent Island Roofing 對 Kent Island Roofing & Siding LLC）就當同一家，並發問確認。
6. **A6 未保險分包金額與日期**：全額算薪資；付款日當作施工日。
7. **A7 沒有工時紀錄的兼職工作**：不按敘述、職稱或營收拆分（Larkspur 的營收檔刻意不用）。

1. **PM 給的資料夾裡沒有分類指南。** `employer-files` 資料夾只有六個雇主子資料夾；`classification-guide.md` 在上一層的「CH03 premium audit」資料夾（和作業 Doc 放在一起）。我是查了上一層才找到。學員如果只拿到 employer-files 的連結，會找不到指南。這一層只有三個項目：employer-files、classification-guide.md、作業 Doc，沒有其他檔案。

每一條都寫在 `references/decision-rules.md`，也印在受影響那家的報告段落，並轉成一題問雇主。

1. **A1 辦公室人員到工地**：只要有工地簽到紀錄，就不算「confined to an office」（CG-04）；沒有工時紀錄可拆（CG-07），整筆薪資歸主要業務 code（CG-02），不管去幾次。只有 C-110 的公司（Harbor）則維持 C-110 並發問。
2. **A2 主要業務 code**：用紀錄算出 C-110 以外薪資最多的 code。
3. **A3 出差津貼**：有記錄出差天數、按最常見日額（65.00）以內的部分算有據可查的費用，不算薪資；超過的部分或沒有天數的（Kyle Brandt 390.00）算薪資。Tyrone Banks 日額 47.00 不同，已發問。
